Common.Name: Name
Dialog.ErrorTitle: SkeldForge could not complete that action
Setup.Title: Find your vanilla Among Us installation
Setup.Description: SkeldForge uses your legitimate Steam copy as a clean source for isolated modpacks. Normal mod operations never change this folder.
Setup.NotDetected: Among Us could not be detected automatically.
Setup.ValidPath: This is a valid Among Us installation.
Setup.InvalidPath: This folder does not appear to contain a valid Among Us installation.
Setup.ValidationHint: The folder must contain Among Us.exe, Among Us_Data, GameAssembly.dll, and UnityPlayer.dll.
Home.Welcome: Keep vanilla clean. Build modded worlds.
Home.Description: Create isolated Among Us instances, install packages safely, and switch between modpacks without touching your original game.
Home.NoRecent: Launch a modpack and it will appear here.
Home.NoModpacks: No modpacks yet. Create your first isolated instance to get started.
Modpacks.Title: Modpacks
Modpacks.Description: Each modpack is a separate copy made from your own vanilla installation.
Modpacks.Sort.Name: Name
Modpack.CreateDescription: SkeldForge will copy your local vanilla game into its writable data folder. The Steam installation stays unchanged.
Modpack.DeleteMessage: This removes the isolated instance for “{0}”. Your original Steam Among Us installation will not be affected.
Modpack.NoMods: No mods are installed in this instance.
Modpack.DropTitle: Drop a mod ZIP or DLL here
Modpack.DropDescription: SkeldForge analyzes every archive before anything is installed.
Modpack.ImportSafety: The configuration never contains Among Us game files. Missing mods are not downloaded automatically.
Modpack.UpdateAvailable: The Steam game has changed since this instance was created.
Modpack.CheckingGameUpdate: Comparing this instance with the current Steam installation…
Modpack.GameUpdateUnknown: The source game has not been compared yet.
Modpack.GameUpdateDetected: Steam Among Us has changed since this instance was created.
Modpack.GameCurrent: This instance uses the current detected Steam base.
Modpack.GameUpdateCheckFailed: Could not compare the current game with this instance.
Modpack.UpdateGameMessage: SkeldForge will first create a full recoverable instance backup, copy the current Steam base into a staging area, and reapply tracked enabled mods. Game updates can break mod compatibility. Your Steam installation will not be changed.
Package.Title: Review mod package
Package.Safe: No unsafe archive paths were detected.
Package.Unsafe: This archive was rejected because it contains an unsafe path.
Package.UnknownStructure: SkeldForge could not confidently identify this package structure. You can inspect its files before deciding, but path safety is never relaxed.
Package.Duplicate: This exact package already exists in the Mod Library.
Package.InstallFailed: The mod was not installed. No completed installation was recorded.
Package.DropOnlyZip: Drop one .zip or .dll mod at a time.
ModLibrary.Title: Mod Library
ModLibrary.Description: Packages you import are hashed and stored here so they can be reused without the original ZIP.
ModLibrary.Sort.Name: Name
Mod.RemoveMessage: SkeldForge will remove files owned exclusively by “{0}”. Shared files will be preserved and reported.
Mod.NoDependencies: No dependency requirement could be identified with confidence.
Cleanup.Title: Vanilla Cleanup
Cleanup.Intro: This feature helps return the main Steam Among Us installation to a vanilla state by removing positively identified mod components.
Cleanup.Step1: The Steam Among Us folder is scanned.
Cleanup.Step2: Known mod and mod-loader components are identified and classified.
Cleanup.Step3: You review every item proposed for removal.
Cleanup.Step4: Nothing is removed without your confirmation.
Cleanup.Step5: Every selected file is backed up before cleanup begins.
Cleanup.Step6: The folder is scanned again and a change report is produced.
Cleanup.UnknownSafety: Unknown files are never removed automatically.
Cleanup.ConfirmTitle: Back up and remove known mod components?
Cleanup.ConfirmMessage: SkeldForge will first back up every selected item. If the backup fails, cleanup stops without removing anything.
Cleanup.NoKnown: No known SkeldForge-detectable mod components were found.
Cleanup.PermissionHint: If Steam is installed in a protected folder, Windows may prevent cleanup. SkeldForge does not elevate silently.
Backups.Title: Backups
Backups.Description: Review and restore backups created before cleanup or instance maintenance.
Backups.Empty: No backups have been created yet.
Backups.DeleteMessage: This permanently removes the backup “{0}”. The action cannot be undone.
Backups.RestoreMessage: Existing newer or changed files will not be overwritten silently. Conflicts will be reported.
Backups.OverwriteMessage: The restore report found different files at one or more destinations. Continuing will replace those files with the verified backup copies. This cannot be undone automatically.
Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Description: Paths and preferences are stored per user. Resetting settings never deletes games, modpacks, or backups.
Settings.ResetMessage: Language, paths, and window preferences will be reset. Modpacks, imported mods, backups, and Among Us files will not be deleted.
Settings.PathInvalid: Choose a valid Among Us installation before saving.
Settings.DataMoveNote: Changing the data folder affects new operations; existing data is not moved automatically.
About.Purpose: SkeldForge manages isolated Among Us modpack instances while helping keep the original Steam installation clean.
About.SafetyBody: Mod packages are analyzed before installation, archive paths are validated, and normal mod operations target only SkeldForge instances.
About.License: No Among Us game files or third-party mods are included with SkeldForge.
Success.ModImported: “{0}” was added to the Mod Library.
Success.InstanceBackupCreated: The full instance backup was created and verified.
Success.InstanceUpdated: The instance base was updated and enabled mods were reapplied.
Error.InvalidGamePath: The selected folder is not a valid Among Us installation.
Error.GameMissing: Among Us could not be found. Check the Steam installation path.
Error.ZipCorrupt: The ZIP archive is damaged or cannot be read.
Error.ZipUnsafe: The ZIP archive contains an unsafe path. No files were installed.
Error.ZipUnsupported: The archive structure could not be installed safely.
Error.DiskSpace: There is not enough disk space to create this modpack instance.
Error.Permission: Windows denied access to a required file or folder.
Error.FileLocked: A required file is in use by another application.
Error.InstanceCorrupt: The isolated instance is incomplete or corrupted.
Error.ExecutableMissing: Among Us.exe is missing from the selected installation.
Error.BackupFailed: The backup could not be completed. No cleanup files were removed.
Error.RestoreConflict: Some files changed after this backup and were not overwritten.
Error.ModConflict: The package conflicts with files owned by another installed mod. Nothing was overwritten.
Error.InvalidJson: A SkeldForge data file is invalid or damaged.
Error.Localization: The selected language could not be loaded. English is being used.
Error.Launch: Among Us could not be launched.
Error.GameAlreadyRunning: Among Us is already running. Close every Among Us window and wait a few seconds before trying again.
Error.IncompatibleGameVersion: This mod does not support the Among Us version in this instance. Install a compatible mod release or create the instance from a supported game version.
Error.Generic: The operation could not be completed. See the log for technical details.
Conflict.Title: Mod conflict
Conflict.Description: SkeldForge will not silently overwrite files supplied by another mod.
Restore.Message.Conflict: A different file exists and requires explicit overwrite approval.
Restore.Message.Skipped: The existing file already matches the backup.
Restore.Message.Error: This file could not be restored. See the application log for technical details.
